), cycles AS (
 SELECT operbotdetref AS robot_key, SUM(progcyclecount) AS tpc, AVG(cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time_seconds
 FROM operation GROUP BY operbotdetref
), metrics AS (
 SELECT r.botcode AS robot_id, w.avg_tool_usage_severity, w.total_wear / NULLIF(c.tpc, 0) AS twr, c.tpc, c.avg_cycle_time_seconds
 FROM robot_record r

FROM metrics
ORDER BY twr DESC NULLS LAST, tpc DESC NULLS LAST
